text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS21, Dragonfly Door Knocker in Polished Brass and Bronze

The 4-1/2 Inch Polished Brass Dragonfly Door Knocker is beautiful, with stunning detail and expert craftsmanship. This front door knocker is finished in polished brass and bronze. It is 4-1/2 inches tall and 6-1/2 inches wide. It comes packaged with all the necessary hardware to surface mount it on wood or metal doors. The Dragonfly Door Knocker in Polished Brass and Bronze is a great choice for a housewarming gift or as a wedding present since dragonflies have long been a symbol of new beginnings and love.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Bronze
  • Height: 4-1/2
  • Width: 6-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 1"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
